**New in 1.4**
- **Categories picked for you.** StockUp chooses Shutterstock, Adobe and Dreamstime categories from each photo's title and keywords, tagged "auto" so you can see which ones it picked. **Auto-pick** redoes them for the photos you select. Categories you choose yourself are never changed. Editorial photos also get a Dreamstime editorial category. You can turn this off in Settings.
- **Pause and Resume.** These work instantly, even partway through a photo. The half-sent file is removed from the site, and the photo is sent again from the start when you resume.
- **Stop now means now,** with the same clean-up. If a photo has already been fully sent and is only waiting for the site to confirm it, StockUp finishes it first; the progress card says so.
- **Big batches open instantly.** You can start tagging straight away while StockUp checks your photos in the background, with a progress strip. Reopening a batch is instant because StockUp remembers what it already checked.
- **Fix:** if a connection dropped partway through a photo, the retry could mistake StockUp's own half-sent file for a finished one and skip it. Now it replaces it.

**Downloads:** `StockUp-Mac.zip` (Apple silicon), `StockUp-Windows.zip`, or `stockup.py`. Script users can press **Update now** in StockUp. App users: download the new zip, quit the old app, and open the new one.
